0: CHUBUKOV. Devil take him! [Walks about in excitement.]
1: NATALYA STEPANOVNA. What a rascal! What trust can one have in one's neighbours after that!
3: NATALYA STEPANOVNA. The monster! First he takes our land and then he has the impudence to abuse us.
4: CHUBUKOV. And that blind hen, yes, that turnip-ghost has the confounded cheek to make a proposal, and so on! What? A proposal!
6: CHUBUKOV. Why, he came here so as to propose to you.
7: NATALYA STEPANOVNA. To propose? To me? Why didn't you tell me so before?
8: CHUBUKOV. So he dresses up in evening clothes. The stuffed sausage! The wizen-faced frump!
9: NATALYA STEPANOVNA. To propose to me? Ah! [Falls into an easy-chair and wails] Bring him back! Back! Ah! Bring him here.
11: NATALYA STEPANOVNA. Quick, quick! I'm ill! Fetch him! [Hysterics.]
12: CHUBUKOV. What's that? What's the matter with you? [Clutches at his head] Oh, unhappy man that I am! I'll shoot myself! I'll hang myself! We've done for her!
13: NATALYA STEPANOVNA. I'm dying! Fetch him!
14: CHUBUKOV. Tfoo! At once. Don't yell! [Runs out. A pause. NATALYA STEPANOVNA wails.]
15: NATALYA STEPANOVNA. What have they done to me! Fetch him back! Fetch him! [A pause.] [CHUBUKOV runs in.]
16: CHUBUKOV. He's coming, and so on, devil take him! Ouf! Talk to him yourself; I don't want to....
18: CHUBUKOV. [Yells] He's coming, I tell you. Oh, what a burden, Lord, to be the father of a grown-up daughter! I'll cut my throat! I will, indeed! We cursed him, abused him, drove him out, and it's all you... you!
19: NATALYA STEPANOVNA. No, it was you!
20: CHUBUKOV. I tell you it's not my fault. [LOMOV appears at the door] Now you talk to him yourself [Exit.]
